{{Card |title=Gift Of The Mentor |hatnote=For the Holotable remaster / errata face, see [[Gift Of The Mentor (Errata)]]. |card_uid=1_82o |image=Premiere-L-giftofthementor-decipher-archive.gif |hires_image=Premiere-L-giftofthementor-hires.webp |side=Light |type=Interrupt |subtype=Lost Interrupt |subtype_link=Lost Interrupt |set=Premiere Limited |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |rarity=R1 |rarity_link=Rarity#Rare |uniqueness=Unique |destiny=5 |icons=[[Interrupt]] |version_label=printed |set_band=Decipher |prev=Full Throttle |next=Han's Back |lore=Luke relied on Obi-Wan’s knowledge and advice to learn the ways of the Force. Obi-Wan continued to counsel Luke long after the old Jedi’s apparent ‘death.’ |game_text=If Luke and Obi-Wan or Yoda are in a battle together, you may add two battle destiny. OR Use 1 Force to search through your Reserve Deck and take any one lightsaber into your hand. Shuffle deck, cut and replace. |printings='''Decipher''' — '''this page''' (1_82)
'''Decipher (Unlimited)''' — [[Gift Of The Mentor (Unlimited)]] (51_82)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' - [[Gift Of The Mentor (Japanese)]] (1301_82o), [[Premiere (Japanese)]], April 1997
'''Decipher Errata''' — [[Gift Of The Mentor (Errata)]] (1_82) |sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20020611184117/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/premiere/light/index.html Premiere Light Side card list] at Decipher.com (archive, 11 June 2002) * Original printed face: [https://web.archive.org/web/20020804005247/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/premiere/light/small/giftofthementor.html Gift Of The Mentor], [[Decipher]] (archived 4 August 2002). * Printed face: [https://web.archive.org/web/20020804005247/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/premiere/light/images/giftofthementor.gif Decipher.com card image] (Wayback copy of decipher.com/starwars/cardlists) |strategy=By Jim Van Fleet, RED 15https://web.archive.org/web/20020202042117/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/premiere/light/small/giftofthementor.html This interrupt from the Premiere edition has remained in my Light Side tournament deck longer than any other, and I find I never fail to use it in the game. Call it sentiment, a reminder of that favorite movie scene when [[Obi-Wan Kenobi{{!}}Obi-Wan]] gives [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Luke]] his father's lightsaber, and introduces us to this elegant weapon. [[Gift Of The Mentor]] is an elegant weapon, too. If [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Luke]] finds himself in battle together with either of his mentors, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi{{!}}Obi-Wan]] or [[Yoda]], it allows the Light Side to draw two additional battle destiny. Three battle destiny are usually enough to sweep away the Dark Side characters opposing these Jedi. The secondary use, allowing the player to use 1 Force to search the Reserve Deck for any lightsaber, is key in many decks that require a fast start and Force drain bonuses from lightsabers. It is also nice to have a card in your deck that cuts down on the use of duplicate copies of [[Obi-Wan's Lightsaber]] or [[Anakin's Lightsaber]]. [[Gift Of The Mentor]] is a lost interrupt, but has a great destiny of 5. It can be Sensed, but this can be anticipated and prevented by [[Control]]. The most dangerous counter to [[Gift Of The Mentor]] is the Dark Side used interrupt [[Boring Conversation Anyway]], but that is another card extra . . . |pulled_by=* [[Return Of A Jedi (V)]][https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Gift%20Of%20The%20Mentor Scomp: Gift Of The Mentor]; card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json swccg-card-json Light.json] (commit d4e661ec).
